Name: Animals Don't Remove Grass
Author: MrShreddie
Description:
[size=2]This mod is inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7474]KarratKake's mod[/url] which has a near identical functionality, though I made this to be compatible for 1.6 and added customisable toggles for different types of grass (as 1.6 added in [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Grass#Blue_Grass]Blue Grass[/url])
 [/size][size=5]
Install[/size]
[list]
[*][size=2][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/size]
[*][size=2]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/size]
[*][size=2]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size]
[/list]
[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6.[/size]
[*][size=2]Works in single player and multiplayer[/size]
[/list]
[size=5]Config[/size]
[size=2]By default, all grass type tiles will remain if animals graze on them. Toggles can be used (via the config.json file or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM [/url]if installed) to change how blue and regular grass behaves.

If, for example you wanted regular grass to behave normally but wanted blue grass to not be removed, you can set the values in config.json to:
[code]﻿{
  "ToggleBlue": true,
  "ToggleRegular": false
}
[/code]
[/size]Or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/B294WFB.png[/img]
